race.comment: MR KIMBLE (5) sets the standard after resuming with a sound second at Murray Bridge, beaten just under two lengths in a Mdn. He has placed three times from six starts overall, handles soft ground well enough and Todd Pannell sticking adds to the confidence. On top. DEDSET MAGIC (1) has been improving through the campaign and was only beaten just over three lengths behind Katrina's Legacy last start, though the wide draw and lack of a placing from four starts are against. Can feature on best. BUFFO (14) is eased from Saturday company after finishing seventh at Morphettville Parks and has a 2kg claim on the quick back-up, but his last two efforts leave him with something to prove. TAI PO JEWEL (12) is third-up after a better second at Naracoorte and brings a genuine place profile if she can repeat that effort.
